note_en: A plain 比 comparison (A 比 B 强) can be made stronger with 要 before the adjective and 得多 after it: 恐怕比官方公布的要强烈得多 "probably much stronger than officially announced." English puts "much" before the adjective, but Chinese adds 得多 after it, and you can't use 很 or 非常 in a 比 sentence (比他很高 is wrong). 要 just adds emphasis and can be left out.
